import numpy as np

def rlhf_step(prompt, response, reward_model, ref_model, kl_coeff, ppo_clip):
    r = reward_model(prompt, response)
    kl_divergence = np.sum(response * np.log(response / (ref_model + 1e-8)))
    total_reward = r - kl_coeff * kl_divergence
    ratio = response / (ref_model + 1e-8)
    clipped_ratio = np.clip(ratio, 1 - ppo_clip, 1 + ppo_clip)
    surrogate = np.minimum(ratio * total_reward, clipped_ratio * total_reward)
    return {"total_reward": total_reward, "kl_penalty": kl_coeff * kl_divergence, "ppo_loss": -np.mean(surrogate)}
